root_cause.text: The workqueue (`idxd->wq`) was not destroyed in the `idxd_conf_device_release()` function when the device object is freed, causing a resource leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `destroy_workqueue(idxd->wq);` to `idxd_conf_device_release()` in `drivers/dma/idxd/sysfs.c`, and the commit message states: "The workqueue associated with an DSA/IAA device is not released when the object is freed."

This line obtains the pointer to idxd, which contains the workqueue member idxd->wq that is not being destroyed. Without this pointer, the workqueue could not be accessed for cleanup.
This line frees a resource (groups) but serves as an example of the pattern. The absence of a similar call to destroy the workqueue (e.g., destroy_workqueue(idxd->wq)) causes the resource leak.
